$comment: Czech typography. Quotes „…“ primary as macOS cs writes them (839 „…“ pairs across the pile's Finder/AppKit/System Settings strings), ‚…‘ nested (AppKit NSSpellChecker quote styles show ‚abc‘). Ellipsis is the single … hugging its word (macOS cs: Hledat frází…). Apostrophe ’ declared for the rare foreign word. Spacing: Czech typographic norm (ČSN 01 6910) keeps a one-letter preposition or conjunction (k s v z o u a i) off the line end, so it takes a no-break space U+00A0, not a plain space; a deliberate typographic choice, since macOS itself writes plain spaces there. Multipliers spell 4× or 4krát, never 4x. Hedges: bracketed or slashed gender/plural endings. Percent is left free: Czech spaces a noun percent (42 %) and writes the adjective tight (42%), and macOS cs mixes both. Schema: docs/i18n/termbase.md § <tag>/mechanics.json schema.

spacing.why: a one-letter preposition or conjunction (k s v z o u a i) takes a no-break space U+00A0 after it, never a plain space (ČSN 01 6910)
Czech quotes hug their text: no space inside „…“

hedges.why: a bracketed gender or plural ending (soubor(y), smazán(a), byl(a)); use ICU plural/select, or restructure (Zkopírováno)
a slashed ending (byl/a, smazán/a); restructure impersonally or use ICU select
